Krafton to invest additional $250 million in India

South Korean gaming company Krafton, the creator of the battle royale game BGMI, announced plans to invest an additional $250 million in India over the next few years. The new investment will double Krafton's total capital deployed in the country. The funds are intended to expand the firm’s operations beyond gaming, including backing Indian startups and strengthening its local infrastructure. The announcement was reported by Mint and Outlook India. No further details on specific projects or timelines were provided.
